channel.title: Notes of an old refiner
channel.description: Zapiski starogo neftyanika. Nurzhan, the dacha, and life on a pension

item.title: Dacha closed for winter
item.description: Closed the dacha yesterday. Drained the water, the pipes wrapped, the last apples in the boxes, the jars on the balcony (twenty-eight this year; the doctor says less salt, so less jars). The heating came on 15 October, and already the smog is back over the Chu plain, the radio says unhealthy…

item.title: The big plan
item.description: Dima writes about the "Tulparcoin": he says do not touch it, not a coin, not a cent, and do not let the neighbours tell me about it. I said: I have no money to touch. He answered: that is exactly the point, Ded. I am more interested in the plan for the visit. The boy was born on the 9th of June,…

item.title: Dima can read again
item.description: Dima writes from Surgut: "Ded, your blog opens again! I read three years in one night." So the technical works are finished. Hello, Dima. Hello, Valentina. Hello also to any new readers: the blog of an old man from Nurzhan, 86 years, still working, like the old refinery. Tomatoes this year very…

item.title: Ten years
item.description: Ten years since Lyudmila. In the morning I went to the cemetery with the red carnations and with the tomato seeds from her envelope, I put the little packet in my pocket to show her that I still have them. I sat for an hour. The snow was dry, the sky was blue. A woman sang quietly somewhere far.…

item.title: Minus twenty-seven
item.description: In the night the frost was minus 27. In the morning no internet, and the mobile also bad, one stick, then nothing. I thought my old computer finally died, and I was ready to call Dima in Surgut and cry. But Dima showed me last year a page where Attelkom writes what is broken: status.attelkom.net .…

item.title: Winter jars
item.description: Counting what we have. Twenty-nine jars of pickles, six of the yellow tomato salad, eleven of apricot jam, two of the plums (a gift). Plus the dried apples in the cotton bag. For one old man this is an army. Twenty-nine jars and one kettle. The balcony shelf. I make a list of who should get which…

item.title: Victory Day, 80 years
item.description: The eighty years. I went to the Eternal Fire with my father's photograph, as every year, but this time I carried it in a small frame, because the large one is too heavy for my arm. A girl from the school asked to photograph us, the old man with the old man in the frame. I said yes. A strange thing…

item.title: Prices
item.description: For the history (somebody will read this in 50 years): pension 1,410 som. Electricity from January is 0.32 som per kilowatt, Iradenergo now. A loaf of bread 3 som, buckwheat 1 kg 14 som, my heart pills 65 som, these are in dollars really. The marshrutka 2 som. I don't complain. In 1992 there was…

item.title: A good year for the apricot
item.description: The old apricot gave again, even more than in 2010. 85 kilos. The neighbours helped to pick, and I gave a bucket to each. I have no strength for the jam, so the neighbour from the second floor comes on Wednesday and does it with me. Seven jars so far. The old apricot tree, 12 July. Still standing,…

item.title: Spring, and the technical works
item.description: The technical works on the international channel are in the sixth month now. I write for the Irad readers and for the future, a post in a bottle. In Nurzhan the spring comes the old way: first the mud, then the sparrows, then the first dandelion on the south side of the refinery fence. The Chu in…
